sermon.title: Christ Does - April 16, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: In Revelation, Christ is the one who does: He holds the keys, cleanses His church to be without spot or wrinkle, gathers a harvest from every nation, prays that we be one, and alone opens the scroll. Our part is to respond—worship, open the door, and let Him finish us.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.section_question: What does Christ do with the keys?
chunks.short_answer: Continuing in Revelation: He opens what no one shuts and shuts what no one opens—God is in control.
chunks.text:
Thank you. Jesus. You may find your seats this morning we’re going to continue in Revelations this morning we were learning about who Christ is and what he gives and today we’re going to learn about what he does. And what he wants to do. Amen. Jesus has some plans for his church.

Writer I’m a little loud can you turn turn me down in the main. Jesus has plans for his church. We learn here in the scriptures we’re going to learn here in the scriptures that Jesus is in charge Jesus is the builder. And he went he wants a great harvest. And he wants unity. He also opens. Jesus opens I’m not going to tell you what that is yet but we’ll learn in a few minutes here. Jesus has great plans for his people and for his church. In Revelations chapter 5 verse 5 says the lion of the tribe of Judah has prevailed to open the scroll and to loose its seven seals Revelations 3:7 says he who has the key of David who opens and no one shuts and shuts and no man opens.

You he can’t open what he has shot and we can’t shut what he has opened if God doesn’t want to do something or use something it’s not going to work if you try to use it. If God has backed off of healing. No matter what you do it’s not going to happen if God’s not going to heal you’re not going to work him up to heal. When he shuts the door the door shuts. And when he opens the door you can’t close. These spiritual gifts the spiritual gifts of God are just a means to the goal God heals people because he wants to show that he is the king of kings and the Lord of lords. It is the means is the goal they are not the goal Jesus Christ is the goal amen and everything in the Old Testament and every all the examples they point to him.

But that does not mean that we give up on what the scriptures say and what Paul wrote to come in and prophesy and do not forbid the speaking of tongues and we want spirit the spirit of God to come in the service the scriptures say we’re two or three are gathered there he is in our midst so we exercise the principles the same the same principles amen. Revelation chapter 118 I am he who lives was dead and behold I am alive forevermore I have the keys of hades and of death. Jesus God is God regardless of you whether you believe in him or not regardless or whether or not he answers your prayer he’s still God. He does what he pleases now he cares about us for sure yes. Him having the keys and having control also means that your eternal destination whether you’re going to heaven or hell is in the hands of Jesus Christ and not anyone else there is no man on earth that is going to get you into heaven there is no church or organization that will get you in to heaven it’s not your intelligence.
